name: Octopus Shape Silicone Face Cleansing Brush 1pcs - Random Colour
description:
Product Name: Octopus Shape Silicone Face Cleansing Brush
Material: Silicone
Shape: Cute Octopus Shape
Size: 5.5 × 5.5 cm
Weight: 16g
Color Options: Light Pink, Light Blue, Purple
Package Includes: 1 Piece Brush
Imported From: China

Key Features & Benefits

Gentle & Effective: Soft silicone bristles provide a mild massage effect, suitable for daily use (twice a day recommended).

Deep Cleansing: Helps exfoliate dead skin, cleanse pores, reduce excess oil, and prevent acne.

Cute & Easy to Hold: Adorable octopus design makes it convenient and comfortable to use.

Durable Material: Made from long-lasting silicone for extended use.

Skin-Friendly: Suitable for all skin types.

Note

Slight color variations may occur due to lighting and monitor differences.

Manual measurement may have a 1–2 cm deviation.
